source.citation: François, M., Geymonat, G., Berthaud, Y. (1998). Determination of the symmetries of an experimentally determined stiffness tensor: application to acoustic measurements. International Journal of Solids and Structures 35, 4091-4106.
source.location: the stiffness as printed in Morin, Gilormini and Derrien (2020), J. Elast. 138, 221-232, equation (50)

transcription.from: the article of Morin et al. (PDF), read on the page text and compared with the image of the page
transcription.note: Stiffness identified by ultrasonic measurements, in the Kelvin-Mandel notation (rows and columns 11, 22, 33, 23, 13, 12, with the factors sqrt(2) and 2), in GPa. The published moduli are those of the Euclidean projection of the stiffness (primal) and of the inverse of the Euclidean projection of the compliance (dual).

k_primal.description: bulk modulus of the isotropic tensor closest to the stiffness, Euclidean distance
k_primal.location: Morin et al. (2020), section 5.2, quoted from Moakher and Norris (2006)

mu_primal.description: shear modulus of the isotropic tensor closest to the stiffness, Euclidean distance
mu_primal.location: Morin et al. (2020), section 5.2, quoted from Moakher and Norris (2006)

k_dual.description: bulk modulus of the inverse of the isotropic tensor closest to the compliance, Euclidean distance
k_dual.location: Morin et al. (2020), section 5.2, quoted from Moakher and Norris (2006)

mu_dual.description: shear modulus of the inverse of the isotropic tensor closest to the compliance, Euclidean distance
mu_dual.location: Morin et al. (2020), section 5.2, quoted from Moakher and Norris (2006)

notes: The dual shear modulus computed from this matrix is 55.78 GPa; the published value is 55.81.
